# hudu_vlan_zone (Resource)

Manages a Hudu VLAN Zone — a logical grouping of related VLANs (e.g. a datacenter, building, or rack range).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hudu_vlan_zone" "east_coast_dc" {
  name           = "East Coast Datacenter"
  company_id     = hudu_company.acme.id
  vlan_id_ranges = "100-500,1000-1500"
  description    = "Primary DC zones"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) ID of the owning company.
- `name` (String) VLAN Zone name.
- `vlan_id_ranges` (String) Comma-separated list of numeric ranges (e.g. `100-500,1000-1500`). Each range must be inside 1-4094 and start <= end.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the VLAN Zone is archived. Archived zones are hidden from the regular Hudu lists but remain retrievable.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the VLAN Zone.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the VLAN Zone was created, in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-01-15T12:34:56.789Z`).
- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned by Hudu, as a string.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated by Hudu.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the VLAN Zone was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC.
- `url` (String) Absolute URL of the VLAN Zone in the Hudu web UI.
- `vlans_count` (Number) Number of VLANs assigned to this zone.
